600001.name: Entrenched 1
600001.SpecificEffects: Trigger <buf ID=900022>[Guard]</buf> to protect adjacent (<color=#F74848>1</color> tile) allies from Assault and Ranged attacks, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

600802.name: 机动截击
600802.describe: 使用机枪攻击单个目标，造成<color=#F74848>1.15</color>倍伤害，对命中的目标施加<buf ID=7101506>[移动阻碍Ⅰ]</buf>，持续<color=#F74848>1</color>回合，若目标位于友方<terrian ID=6008501 />内，额外施加<buf ID=1004021>[武器阻碍]</buf>，持续<color=#F74848>1</color>回合

600803.name: 重振
600803.SpecificEffects: 每次损毁部位被修复时，造成伤害提升<color=#F74848>5%</color>，最多提升<color=#F74848>20%</color>

600804.name: 无可僭越
600804.describe: 替周围<color=#F74848>2</color>格的友军抵挡突击与射击武器的攻击，每回合最多发动<color=#F74848>2</color>次，同时自身和部署的<terrian ID=6008501 />获得<buf ID=6008041>[磁阻力场]</buf>，持续<color=#F74848>2</color>回合

600805.name: 地利之便

600806.name: 制空封锁

指定场上<color=#F74848>1</color>名敌机，对其施加<buf ID=6008061>[制空封锁]</buf>；
场上存在自身部署的<terrian ID=6008501 />时才能使用

600807.name: 身先士卒
600807.SpecificEffects: 遭受伤害降低<color=#F74848>10%</color>，<terrian ID=6008501 />内每有<color=#F74848>1</color>名友军，反击伤害提升<color=#F74848>5%</color>，最多提升<color=#F74848>15%</color>

600808.name: 战终
600808.describe: 使用机枪攻击<range type=1>面前3×2格</range>范围内的所有目标，造成<color=#F74848>0.6</color>倍范围伤害，若目标位于友方<terrian ID=6008501 />内，则额外施加<buf ID=1009083>[震慑]</buf>，持续<color=#F74848>1</color>回合

600022.name: Armor Specialization 2
600022.SpecificEffects: When performing <buf ID=900022>[Guard]</buf>, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

600031.name: Indestructible 1
600031.SpecificEffects: When the Arm suffers overdamage, trigger <buf ID=900003>[Guts]</buf>, locking to <color=#F74848>1</color> HP, effective <color=#F74848>1</color> time per battle.

600033.name: Adaptive Warfare 1
600033.SpecificEffects: At the end of the action, if an Active Attack was not initiated this turn, an extra <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles can be moved.

600034.name: Indestructible 2
600034.SpecificEffects: The part that triggers <buf ID=900003>[Guts]</buf> restores <color=#F74848>35%</color> of its HP after combat.

600035.name: Indestructible 3
600035.SpecificEffects: Make <buf ID=900003>[Guts]</buf> able to trigger again after <color=#F74848>3</color> turns, with no effective time limit for each battle.

600036.name: Indestructible 4
600036.SpecificEffects: When any part suffers overdamage, trigger <buf ID=900003>[Guts]</buf>.

600043.name: Entrenched 4
600043.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900022>[Guard]</buf> can now be triggered an unlimited number of times per turn.

600844.name: 老骥伏枥2
600844.SpecificEffects: 部署<terrian ID=6008501 />时释放距离延长<color=#F74848>1</color>格

600845.name: 老骥伏枥3
600845.SpecificEffects: 在场时，部署的<terrian ID=6008501 />内友军免疫来自敌机的<buf ID=900079>[位移]</buf>效果，无法被施加<buf ID=900080>[禁止援护]</buf>和<buf ID=900081>[禁止被援护]</buf>类效果

600846.name: 老骥伏枥4
600846.SpecificEffects: 部署的<terrian ID=6008501 />持续时间结束时，对领域及其周围<color=#F74848>1</color>圈范围内敌机的所有部位造成最大耐久值<color=#F74848>15%</color>的<buf ID=900017>[固定伤害]</buf>
